text:
ada: Quick thread 52 We need a tiny 'grant preview' UX for role bindings so admins can see effective privileges + quota impact before they hit Confirm. idea: modal with Preview step calling backend dry-run.

noah: Agree. Must show per-route quota estimate + reason for any denied route. keep copy concise: 'Preview shows effective access and cost impact.'

ravi: API note: I can add POST /admin/role-bindings/preview that returns arrays of {route, allowed, effective_role, estimated_tokens_per_month, reasons[]}. dry_run=true makes it idempotent.

kevin: Security: every confirm must create an audit event with actor, reason, and preview_snapshot_id. preview_snapshot_id lets support reproduce the preview exactly. Also require org_admins to re-auth (2FA) on confirm for prod.

noah: UX: show a tiny badge for "requires 2FA" in the Confirm button state. For denied routes, include an inline "why" line and a link to policy help.

ravi: Implementation caveat: route-level policies can be inherited from tenant defaults. preview must compute effective policy by combining role template, tenant overrides, and route flags. that could be slow; we'll cache template merges for 10s.

ada: Telemetry plan: emit events: rbinding_preview_open, rbinding_preview_result (with counts: allowed, denied), rbinding_apply_trigger, rbinding_apply_outcome. add tags: mode=temp|bind, source=console, preview_id.

kevin: For rollout: feature-flag at org level. start with internal orgs, then pilot 3 customers, then ramp. Keep legacy grant flow available as fallback.

sec-bot: Note: require audit retention policy >= 1 year for orgs using binding feature.

ravi: Also want to return a compact diff in preview: what privileges change compared to current effective privileges. makes it clear if you're removing something unintentionally.

noah: Good call. UX: show diff lines like +/-. also include a tiny "revert window" option for 24h after apply. revert should create its own audit event.

ada: Action items: ravi to open RFC and implement preview API (RFC-2041), kevin to confirm 2FA enforcement touchpoints, noah to mock preview UI and diffs, sec to confirm audit retention. sync Wed.

kevin: I'll add a note about not allowing wildcard grants (e.g., /v1/*) unless org policy permits.

ada: Thanks all. we'll keep preview dry-run quick and informative. :thumbsup:
